capabilities: Track recurring monthly expenses with payment status and confirmation numbers
Generate monthly tracking notes with checkboxes for each expense
Carry over unpaid expenses to the next month automatically
Generate expense reports for a custom date range
Show unpaid expense count in the status bar and a sidebar dashboard
disambiguation: Not a general budgeting tool; it tracks only fixed monthly recurring expenses, not one-time or variable spending.
extras: The manifest mentions reminders and payment notifications, but the README lists reminders only under a roadmap of unimplemented future features. Data is stored in a plugin JSON file plus generated monthly notes in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track recurring monthly payments, their paid status, or overdue items over time.
summary: Recurring monthly expense tracker with a dashboard for marking bills and subscriptions paid, carrying over unpaid items, and generating reports.
